en:
But remember, it's a collector's item.
There are probably others trying to get their hands on it.
I wish you the best of luck, brother!

Right, it sounds like I should hurry.
Well, thanks for everything.
So Much Less!
Hmmm! Close, but no cigar!
What!? I could've sworn that was it...

If you can't answer my question, you'll
never be my true brother. Try again!
Please, No More!

That's what I should be saying to you
with an answer like that.
What!? I got it wrong?

If you can't answer my question, you'll never
be my true brother. Try again!

Sorry, I got a little confused earlier.
I'm ready now, though. Give me the question.
Hey, I have something to ask you.
Yes, what is it, sir?

I heard you guys had a rare photo of
Haruka Sawamura here. Do you still have it in stock?

Well, we did get one in recently,
but I actually sold it moments ago.
What!? A-All right then. Thank you...
I look forward to your next visit, sir.

Wh-What are you guys doing!? Give it back!
Keep your filthy hands off my Haruka-chan!

What're you whinin' over this
little scrap of trash for, huh?

Hey, nerd! How 'bout you give us So Much More of yer
money instead of buyin' this crap? You got more, yeah?
G-Give it back!

That's enough outta you.
Just hurry up and give us your wallet!
The hell do you want?
You there.
Huh? Y-You mean me?

Yeah, that's right.
Are you a fan of Haruka Sawamura?
The hell's this bitch sayin'?
What's your answer?
Y-Yes, I'm a huge fan.
What's all this about, gramps?

You punks just ran out of luck.
I can't let you abuse a Haruka fan like this.
Huh? You trippin', man?

Whatever. C'mon, we're just gonna have
to take both of their wallets instead!

The hell's up with this nerd?
Why's he so strong!?
Hey, are you okay?
Y-Yes! Thank you so much for helping me!
Here. I got your picture back for you.
Oh, actually...

I'd like to give it to you!
Think of it as a gift for rescuing me!

I might be wrong about this,
but you're a Haruka-chan fan too, aren't you?

You had this determined look on your face when you
asked if I was a fan myself. That made it kinda obvious.

Besides, it was really cool seeing you
beat the crap out of those guys.

Please, take it. This picture is gonna
be happier with you, I just know it.
Thank you. Fandom really is a bizarre thing, huh?

I guess you're right. Honestly, I'm just happy I got
to meet someone else who likes Haruka-chan.

It's been getting harder and harder
to support her publicly lately.
Have you followed Haruka-chan since the beginning?

Yeah, of course! I was even there for her
final show at the Japan Dome a couple of years ago!

The media kept calling her the yakuza's daughter,
saying she betrayed her fans by lying to us.
But I don't think she betrayed us at all.

The courage and strength her songs gave me was real.
I can't fault her for some personal issues after that.

If Haruka-chan finds her way back on stage, I'll be there
cheering my lungs out for her every step of the way.

I'm glad to hear that. It sounds like
Haruka's even luckier than she realizes.
Oh, it's nothing. Thanks again.

I'm the one who should be thanking you!
You really saved my skin, fellow Haruka fan!

All right, I should bring this back to Ayaka.
I think she's over in the Children's Park.
Oh! Mister Kazuma-san!
Here you go. This is your present.
Wow, it's amazing! She's so pretty!
Thanks a bunch, Mister!
Take care of it, okay?

I will! I'll treasure it forever!
This is the best!

I'm gonna go home and decorate it now!
Bye bye, Mister! Thank you so much!
Of course. Be safe on your way home, okay?

Phew, she seems thrilled with that picture.
It was definitely worth all the trouble.

Oh, Mister Kazuma! I'm so glad I found you!
I've been looking everywhere!
Here, I made you a drawing!
It's me, Haruka-chan, and you, Mister Kazuma!
You included me?

Well, you're Haruka-chan's dad,
right Mister Kazuma?
How did you know...?
I realized it the first time you talked to me!

When you mentioned Haruka-chan,
your eyes lit up like only a dad's eyes would.

I love my dad. He has the warmest,
most calmest eyes in the world.
That's kinda how you looked, Mister.
I guess I can't hide it.
Anyways, Haruka-chan's just an idol to me.

But it's different for you. You probably
know like, everything about her, Mister.

Someday, I wanna hang out with you guys. Just me,
Haruka-chan, and Mister Kazuma. That's why I drew this!
It's actually pretty good. They look just like us.
Thanks. Um, I wish Haruka-chan could see it, too.
Yeah. I was thinking the same thing.

You know what? I'll take it upon myself
to make sure she gets it.
I promise you.
Thanks so much, Mister!

Oh, it's really late! My mom's gonna be
super worried if I'm not home soon!

Bye bye, Mister Kazuma.
Please show this to Haruka-chan for me!
Don't worry, I will.
Hm? What just whizzed past me...?
W-Wait for meee!
Hey, is everything okay?

I-If I don't stop Soji,
I... I'm ruined...

Slow down there.
You're not making much sense.
S-Sorry, you're right.
Feeling a bit better now?

Yeah, sitting down really helped.
Even so, Soji's still at large...!

That's what you were saying earlier.
Who is this Soji you keep talking about?
Soji is the name of my cleaning robot.
A cleaning... robot?

Yeah, they've been incredibly popular lately.
They'll clean your room, all on their own!

But mine escaped from my apartment...
I'm out here chasing after him now.
A cleaning robot? Listen...

This sounds like it's
straight out of a manga!
Now then, why are you lying to me?

You can't fool me that easily. Even a guy like
me knows those kinds of things don't exist.

W-Wait, wait, wait!
They really do.

He zoomed by you earlier.
You saw him, didn't you?
You mean that round thing?

Exactly!
That's what vacuums look like nowadays.
What? Seriously!?

Oh, haven't you turned on a TV lately?
They're always showing ads for them.
I had no idea...

When I think of robots, I imagine something
a bit more human-shaped and metallic.
Oh, so something more like RoboCop.

Are we really living in a time where
robots do our cleaning for us?

Yeah! The trend came totally
out of nowhere, but it's really caught on.
I see. Society has sure advanced quickly...

Maybe the robot uprising they keep writing
manga about isn't so far off after all.
Um, I think you might have the wrong idea.

Think back to that little round thing that passed
in front of you earlier. You remember him, right?
That's my cleaning robot.

Seriously? I was expecting something
a bit more human-shaped and metallic.

Oh, no.
Soji's not like RoboCop or anything.

Well, I'm off. I hope you manage
to find this Soji of yours.
H-Hold on a minute, please!

What is it?
Sorry, but I don't have time for this.

Oh... You don't believe me, do you?
Please, I'm telling you the truth.

Who would believe that crap? You claim you're
chasing a runaway robot that vacuums your room.

You might be going through a rough patch right now,
but you're going to have to face reality eventually.

Wait, but this IS reality!
I think you might have the wrong idea.

Y-Yeah. Now that you mention it,
I remember that pretty clearly.

Th-That was Soji!
That's what vacuums look like nowadays.

Either way, vacuum tech is really cutting edge.
I can't believe they actually clean your room.

Cutting edge is right. Once he's done cleaning,
he even plugs himself into a charging station.

So this cleaning robot... Soji.
Why exactly did it run away from you?
Isn't it designed to clean your room?
I'm actually not too sure myself.

I was having him clean my room this morning,
but he suddenly decided to up and ditch me.

Maybe the sensor broke somehow... I've been extra
careful since my girlfriend gave him to me, though.
Huh. So it was a present from your girlfriend.
Yeah... She said I'm too messy for her to handle.

But I always pick up the trash in my room before setting
Soji loose. Don't want him eating anything nasty!
He's precious to me!
I guess you're not as shady as I thought.

It makes sense that it was a gift from your girlfriend.
That explains why you're so desperate to get it back.

I mean, that's one of the reasons,
but there's actually more to the story.

Soji, well... He sucked up my engagement ring
before going on this rampage!

I was thinking about proposing to my girlfriend.
Got a ring ready six months ago just in case.

I kept getting cold feet about the proposal, though.
I'd carry the ring with me, but I never actually proposed.

But today...
Today was going to be the day!

While I was rehearsing this morning, I got so nervous
that my hands started shaking and I dropped the ring.

Then I guess since Soji's sensor was busted,
he sucked it up and fled to the outside world.
Hard to believe that really happened...

Right?
But it did, to me, this morning.
You've certainly got your problems.

I know we just met and all, so this is
a little embarrassing to ask of you...
But could you please find Soji for me!?
Me!?

Yeah. Soji's sensor went haywire,
so he's just running all over the city now.

With how quick his motors are,
there's no way I could ever catch up.

And if I don't have the ring,
I can't propose...
Sorry, but I'm a little too busy right now.

R-Right. Okay, then.
My bad for asking such a big favor of you.

I can't believe you're getting jerked around by a vacuum.
Maybe humanity should lay off the fancy technology.

I know, I know.
I'm sorry for the trouble.

Oh well. All I have to do is catch
that little round thing, right?

Wait, you'll find him for me!?
Thank you so much!
This is a little late, but my name's Fujita.

I'm Kiryu.
I'll let you know once I find it.

Okay.
Thank you again for this.

There's no way I can catch Soji by myself...
Do you think you'd be able to help me out?

Kiryu-san! I hate to nag you about this,
but please catch Soji for me.
Right. I'll have him back soon.
Dirt detected. Dirt detected.
Hey, who the hell's this thing callin' dirt?
Better not be talkin' about us.
Is this little asshole talking shit on us!?

I've had a real crap day so far, but this's perfect.
I'm gonna cheer myself up by wreckin' it!
Please wait!
The hell do you think you are?

That's my robot.
May I please have it back?

Huh?
You got some kinda proof it's yours?

Look on the bottom! Soji's serial number
is QF026848614554. Just look, please!
How'd you even remember that...?
That's how important it is!

Shut your face! Even if you got it right,
that wouldn't prove a goddamn thing!
Huh...? No!

Man, this little shit's even weaker than he looks.
Probly 'cause he gets machines to do everything for him.
Please... Please give it back!
Soji?
Hm. Your little friend is right, Fujita.

I can sense it, too. These three
are clearly a bunch of dirtbags.
The hell're you sayin', grampa!?

Stand up, Fujita.
You're joining me.

If you think Soji's that important, take it back.
Prove how much it means to you.
...Okay!

You two ain't gonna talk so big
once we're through with you!

That's our cue.
Let's go!
You did well for yourself, Fujita.

Now go get your ring back.
You'll be able to propose with pride after this.

I'm just some schmuck who got his engagement ring sucked
up by a vacuum cleaner. What right do I have to propose?

I was so set on proposing to my girlfriend today,
but I'm having second thoughts after all this.

In the end I couldn't even solve my own problem.
I'm pretty pitiful, huh?

My battery is running low.
My battery is running low.
Huh? Toshihiko-kun?

O-Oh, Kotomi-san!
What are you doing here!?

I was walking by when I heard the cleaning robot
I gave you. More importantly, you're hurt!
Oh, that's...
And this is?

Her name is Kotomi-san.
She's my girlfriend.
So this is the girl...

And who's this old man?
A friend of yours?

Uh, yeah.
This is Kiryu-san.

It's nice to meet you.
I'm Kotomi.
Anyway, is that really Soji-chan?

Y-Yeah.
He's been acting a bit funny lately...
Is it running off again!?
Huh? What's wrong, Soji-chan?
What could this be?

A ring...?
Why would Soji-chan have something like this?
Oh, uh, that's...
Toshihiko-kun?

Fujita. To put it lightly,
you can be a real fool sometimes.
First you got your ring stolen by a vacuum cleaner.

Then you ran all around the city chasing it.
Most people would throw in the towel there.

But Fujita... you're a strong guy. You risked
your life to protect what's important to you.

I saw that strength with my own two eyes.
Believe in yourself.
Kotomi-san!
